Health Connect is not available on this phone.
Install or update Health Connect to use these options.
Install or update
Each option asks for its own permission, and you can turn any of them off at any time. Data stays on your phone and in Health Connect.
Save my water to Health Connect
Other health apps can see the drinks you log here.
Count water logged in other apps
Drinks from other apps are added to your day. You choose which apps below.
Keep my weight up to date
New weight readings update your goal, unless you pinned your weight.
Add water for workouts
Exercise sessions from other apps add to that day\'s goal.
Use steps and active calories
Only to show how activity relates to how much you drink. They do not change your goal.
Sync in the background
Check for new data about every 15 minutes, even when the app is closed.
Include older history
Read data from before you connected, up to five years back.
Apps that add water
Apps appear here the first time they share a drink with Health Connect.

How this app uses Health Connect
Everything is optional and each item asks for its own permission. Nothing leaves your phone except through Health Connect, which you control.
Water: saves the drinks you log, and (if you choose) adds drinks logged in other apps to your daily total.
Weight: keeps the weight your goal is based on up to date.
Exercise: adds a little water to the goal on days you work out.
Steps and active calories: shown next to your intake in Insights. They never change your goal.
Background and history access: lets syncing happen while the app is closed and reads data from before you connected.
